units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 6:10">Targ. Jer. VI, 10</cite> <he>למֵיצַת</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 5:3">Targ. Ps. V, 3</cite> <cite ref="R00468"><he>צֵית</he></cite> (imperat.).

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 53:5">Targ. Is. LIII, 5</cite> <he>וכדנָצֵית וכ׳</he> ed. Wil. (v. <cite ref="N00259"><he>נְהֵי</he> I</cite>) and when we listen &c.; a. fr.—Part. <cite ref="R00263"><he>צָיֵית</he></cite>, <he>צָיֵת</he>, <he>צָאִית</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 17:4">Targ. Prov. XVII, 4</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 130:2">Targ. Ps. CXXX, 2</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 63a:1">Keth. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>אי לדידי צ׳</he> if he heeded my advice.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28b:10">Ab. Zar. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>מאן צ׳ ליהודה וכ׳</he> who heeds what Judah the Sabbath-breaker says? <cite ref="Yevamot 89a:12">Yeb. 89ᵃ</cite> <he>בתרי מאני צ׳ … לא צ׳</he> in the case of two vessels, if you tell him that he must give T’rumah from each, he will obey; in the case of one vessel, if you tell him that he must give T’rumah twice, he will not obey.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 113a:4">B. Kam. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>על דלא צ׳ לדינא</he> a warrant issued because he did not heed the decision of the court; <he>כיון דאמר צָיִיתְנָא וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>צָאִיתְנָא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. notes 5, 6) as soon as he says, I shall obey, we tear up the warrant (v. <cite ref="Q02160"><he>פְּתִיחָא</he></cite>); a. e.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 6:28">Targ. Y. Ex. VI, 28</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 1:45">Targ. Deut. I, 45</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 74a:5">B. Bath. 74ᵃ</cite> <he>אצית אי שמעת</he> listen! what dost thou hear?; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 110a">Snh. 110ᵃ</cite> bot.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 38b:6">Ab. Zar. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>לא תְצִיתוּ ליה</he> heed him not.

senses.gloss: to cause to listen. Y. Taan. I, 64ᵃ bot. ובסופה את מְצַיֵּית ליה וכ׳ and finally thou madest him listen (to thee), and he said &c.
